title: Roblox added a MOM button in the 2026 update 💀

clips.prompt: A single blocky Roblox-style avatar stands in a clean neutral-grey exhibition hall, staring up at a large glowing floating holographic UI panel that reads nothing, soft even lighting, dust motes in the light beams.
A second blocky avatar walks in from the right and stops facing the first one, both standing in the same grey exhibition hall, they turn their blocky heads toward each other, small idle movements.

bubbles.speaker: Guest
bubbles.text: press it and your mom joins the server

clips.motion: hard camera shake then quick zoom out
clips.prompt: The blocky avatar slams a giant red arcade button on a pedestal, the ceiling of the grey hall explodes upward in a blinding vertical beam of light, a huge towering blocky mother figure rises through the hole, both small avatars are blasted off their feet and tumble backward, debris cubes flying everywhere.

bubbles.speaker: Mom
bubbles.text: why is your room a mess
